note: Level table shared by client and server (GAME-LOOPS P0-1). requiredXp follows levelFor in server/domain.mjs: 100*(level-1)^2. Every level unlocks one thing to do or wear; nothing here ever changes odds, damage, GOLD or payouts. Numbers in `value` are defaults: the operator can override any entry with LEVEL_TABLE_FILE. `item` entries are level-item editions; they stay hidden and unclaimable unless LEVEL_ITEM_EDITIONS=1 (owner decision pending). `status`: live = works today, coming = shown as a preview until its feature ships.
